_law: Lanes here are REGISTERS, not subject domains. All five share one rendering law (see canon/ferrochrome-art-contract.md) — they are separated so curation can enforce balanced quotas, NOT so they can be trained separately. Splitting these into multiple LoRAs would break the 'same world' property and make the contact lane ungeneratable. See two-lora-stack-research D2 (2026-04-24): single unified World is the default for a project starting from an undifferentiated baseline pile.

lanes.label: Outcast — degraded android (ferro pole)
lanes.description: Field-repaired androids weathered by the planet. ASYMMETRIC (repairs happen where damage happened). Accidental seams — weld scars, mismatched panels, field splices, exposed harness. Oxidation, salt bloom, UV chalk, pitting. Warm sodium light, ZERO body neon. Reads as individual. Target quota ~32.

lanes.label: Cyclops — factory-new android (chrome pole)
lanes.description: Top-of-the-line single-optic units with no history. PERFECTLY SYMMETRIC. Designed seams — deliberate shutlines, panel gaps consistent to the millimetre. Unmarked chrome and carbon fibre, zero wear. Single optic ALWAYS. Cold body neon ALWAYS, as status/branding. Reads as product — two cyclops in frame must be indistinguishable. Target quota ~32.

lanes.label: Welded — cyborg (the between)
lanes.description: Human flesh and machine, neither fully. The ONLY register permitted bare human skin. Partial, intermittent, or failing neon. Mixed seam grammar — surgical where installed, accidental where survived. Target quota ~24.

lanes.label: Contact — two registers in one frame
lanes.description: The highest-value rows in the dataset. Outcast and cyclops (or welded) sharing one frame under one light. These are what prove chrome and rust obey the same rendering law, and they are impossible to express if the registers are trained as separate LoRAs. Target quota ~14.

lanes.label: Material macro
lanes.description: Close studies that teach the physics directly — 2x2 twill weave at consistent panel-relative scale, chrome curvature with horizon line and dark band, neon emitter falloff and spill onto adjacent surfaces. No full figure required. Target quota ~8.
